selection: Whole ContentTabPager.kt as introduced by upstream 35e2fac8a3870a2227a323e19f29f1e93d7e591c and amended by f00cb206f3fa1a5e8f55ebfc78e9c6030ea77f8d (the key(pageCount) pager rebuild guard); unchanged at v0.4.6.
